C Systems

Async TCP Layer 4 Gateway

High-concurrency asynchronous Layer 4 TCP gateway/proxy using epoll. Features round-robin load balancing, instant failover, async health checks with auto-recovery, IPv6 dual-stack, token bucket rate limiting, and SIGUSR1 metrics observability.

NeoShare Local Cloud

Zero-dependency HTTP file server built from scratch with Python stdlib. Threaded architecture, directory traversal protection, 2GB upload limit, HTTP Range streaming for video, auto tar.gz folder downloads, and auto dark/light theme detection.

Modern-YTDLP-GUI

Multi-threaded desktop GUI for yt-dlp with custom Modern UI engine. Non-blocking I/O, real-time progress, format selection, playlist handling, and embedded ffmpeg — all in a responsive dark-themed interface.
